area.note: Regional extent for illustration; not a management boundary.

landcover.note: Classes 52/71; excludes crops, hay/pasture and developed land. Does not establish native species or water reliability.

rap.source: Rangeland Analysis Platform v3 (USDA-NRCS, BLM, Univ. of Montana)
rap.note: Years 1986-2025; normal = 1991-2020; fixed 2024 grassland/shrubland mask; minimum valid coverage 90%

drought.source: U.S. Drought Monitor (NDMC, USDA, NOAA), county statistics
drought.note: Todd County, SD, Mellette County, SD

water.note: 394 perennial stream segments; 1,172 ponds, reservoirs, and lakes

fire.source: USGS/USFS Monitoring Trends in Burn Severity (MTBS)
fire.note: 20 mapped large fires; satellite-mapped record from 1984; generally at least 1,000 acres in the western U.S.; small fires omitted
